title: Transition from Consumer to Producer
intent: Convert attention and resources from pure consumption into generative capacity that increases useful joules for self and others.
eta_goal: Shift the personal thermodynamic balance from net extraction to net creation.
core_framing: Consumption without corresponding creation increases personal and systemic entropy.
Production that serves the least among us compounds η across the network.
Every hour reallocated from passive intake to active making is a direct η gain.
optimized_query_patterns: What is the highest-η productive use of the next 90 minutes given current constraints?
Which consumption patterns are feeding parasitic attention loops?
constraints: Must increase real capability, not merely activity
verification_notes: Ratio of hours spent producing versus consuming, tracked weekly.
next_physical_or_action: Identify one daily consumption habit and replace it with a generative equivalent this week.
